objects.name: Detection technique coverage: linux-obfuscated-files-or-information-base64-decode
objects.description: The following analytic detects the use of the base64 decode command on Linux systems, which is often used to deobfuscate files. It leverages data from Endpoint Detection and Response (EDR) agents, focusing on command-line executions that include "base64 -d" or "base64 --decode". This activity is significant as it may indicate an attempt to hide malicious payloads or scripts.
